h: Shabbos Unites the Reverence of Servants With the Closeness of Children

p: כִּי לִי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עֲבָדִים וְגוֹ׳ (וַיִּקְרָא כה, נה)
"For the Children of Yisrael are servants to Me, etc." (Vayikra 25:55).
the Holy One, blessed be He,
then he is called a servant,
who does the command of his Master
to search through His treasures, etc.
then he is called His beloved son,
like a son who searches through His treasures
and the secrets of His house, etc."
וְאִיתָא בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב כה, א)
And it says in the holy Zohar (II 25a):
"When Yisrael went out of Egypt, etc.,
and since they knew this command
miracles were done for them, etc.;
and at the end of forty years, etc.,
then he taught them in a particular way,
'And you shall know this day, etc.'
for there was no permission before this:
this is in a particular way, etc."
And when one attains in a particular way,
then he is called His beloved son,
who searches through the King's treasures;
that the Ancient of Days concealed,
and what are they? The secrets of the Torah,
וְזֶה הָיָה רַק בִּשְׁעַת מַתַּן תּוֹרָה
And this was only at the time of the Giving of the Torah

and as stated in the holy Zohar (II 82a):
peace be upon him, taught them
at the end of forty years.
And this is the meaning of what is stated
were said in their generalities and details at Sinai;
were said in their details at Sinai,
for they were then in the "particular way,"
the aspect of the beloved son,

And in prayer both are needed:
for prayer is the middah of Malchus,

is like a servant before the king;

who is bound to the root,
when it is in one inclusion

And it says in the holy Zohar (end of Acharei, III 79b)

as is known from the holy Zohar
And this is what is said (Tehillim 55:23):
וַתִּתְפַּלֵּל חַנָּה עַל ה׳ (שְׁמוּאֵל א א, י)
And when one merits the secret of the son,
which is the revelation of Atika,
when he merits the secret of the servant
and the secret of the son,
that is, from the last middah
up to the root, Keser Elyon,
And this is what the holy Zohar says:
"and for the unique one to engage with the Unique One":
of the secret of the son and the secret of the servant,
And this is the holiness of Shabbos,
of which it says in the holy Zohar (Terumah):
"The Holy One, blessed be He, is One, etc.,
to be one with One, etc."
And this is what is written:
"Moshe rejoiced in the gift of his portion";
that he chose for Yisrael in Egypt,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (שְׁמוֹת רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה א, כח)
what reason is given for it:
"for You called him a faithful servant"?
And we said that the intent is
of the three meals of Shabbos.
"for You called him trusted in the house,"
"in all My house he is trusted";
מַה זֶּה לְשׁוֹן עֶבֶד נֶאֱמָן וְכוּלֵּי
But according to what was said,
"Moshe rejoiced in the gift of his portion,"
which is the holiness of Shabbos,
"for You called him a faithful servant":
and to the secret of the son,
to search through the King's treasures
and the secrets of His house:
"a crown of glory on his head."
the tefillin of the Master of the world
"And who is like Your people Yisrael, etc."
for He takes glory in Yisrael;
and this is "a crown of glory
And the Holy One, blessed be He,
the trusted one of the King's house, etc."
הִיא כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּגְּמָרָא (קִידּוּשִׁין פא, א)
This is as stated in the Gemara (Kiddushin 81a),
"Beware of Rabbi Meir and his Torah, etc.;
beware of Rabbi Akiva and his Torah, etc."
for they are called "those who fear My Name"
and this is the secret of the servant.
one merits the revelation of Atika,
to search through the King's treasures
and the secrets of the house;
and this is "to be one with One";
and they can draw down every good,
and keeps his hand from doing any evil";
and it says in Pri Etz Chaim
that one is saved from the accusation of the yetzer hara,
through having merited the secret of the servant
on the Shabbos of Shabbos eve,
and on Shabbos day the secret of the son.
